items.rationale: Preparatory operation for glazing hardware is glazing work (1.3); the optional glazing peril is not shown as agreed, so excluded under 2.6.4 and 3.5(b).
Setting and fitting of the pane is glazing work; excluded under 3.5(b) as the glazing peril is not agreed.
Replacement glazing element; excluded under 2.6.4 and 3.5(a) without the optional glazing cover.
Non-glazing part of the cabinet damaged by sudden impact is covered under 2.6.1 and 4.2.6 with repair costs under 7.1.1(b); fair market price for dent/gouge repair and refinish.
Shelf was hit in the same incident, so it is an affected item under 2.6.2; repair including finish under 7.1.1(b). Small risk it is treated as pre-existing wear.
Under 7.1.12 one attendance is payable in full where indemnified work (the timber repair) was carried out at the visit, without apportionment for the glazing work.
